p: King Street is Hammersmith's main shopping street, and it's a short walk from the Thames, which is where the area really comes into its own.

The riverside between Hammersmith Bridge and Chiswick is lined with historic pubs and makes a lovely walk on a sunny afternoon. The Eventim Apollo, one of London's best-known gig and comedy venues, is just round the corner near the Broadway, and Ravenscourt Park is at the western end of King Street if you want a bit of green. Admiral is strictly 18+, an adult gaming centre rather than a family arcade. If you're catching a show, it's a handy area to grab dinner beforehand.
